purpose: The my-approvals page requests only the actor's pending list with paging and search and links to detail; the detail page shows the fixed approval snapshot, not the live PO, and shows decision controls only for allowedActions plus purchasing.approval; a failed decision keeps the reason, clears the password and retries an uncertain result with the same action and eventId; the settings page sends version, reason and password through the signed update and keeps the reason after an error; submit with approval on requires an approver and sends it; the TASK-018 to TASK-021 client behaviour stays pinned
data: No database or network: mocked services, real discovered pages, and small inline objects of at most 1 approval and 1 line. No fixture files
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged; no timing threshold
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing client test job
cost: Not measured for the new cases. The previous 121 registrations took 1.67 s locally at 64ca24c8; the expected total is 150 registrations. No new job and no capacity workload
